Defeat a group of Ancient Elder Naga that Captain Elora's team has trapped.
{{TOCright}}

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Defeat the Ancient Elder Naga.
* See Captain Elora for your reward.

===Reward===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 750 [[Luxon faction|Luxon Faction]]
* 250 [[Gold]]
* [[Luxon Totem]]

== Walkthrough ==
Start from [[Gyala Hatchery (outpost)|Gyala Hatchery]] and head north into the [[Maishang Hills]]. The Ancient Elder Naga are located just outside the [[portal]], immediately to the east of your starting location. You will have to fight one group of [[Kappa (level 23)|(Archaic) Kappa]] along the way.

If you do not have access to the hatchery, start instead from [[Eredon Terrace]] and head due south, fighting several groups of monsters along the way,  including the necro boss, [[Sessk, Woe Spreader]]. When you reach the coast, activate the resurrection shrine outside of Gyala Hatchery and then head east to the Elder Nagas.

* The ''Ancient Elder Naga'' is a category of Naga, composed of the [[Elder Naga Warrior]], [[Elder Naga Archer|Archer]], and [[Elder Naga Ritualist|Ritualist]].
